criteria.name: Acceptance Criteria and Failure Test Coverage
criteria.description: Every AC- has a test; every endpoint has failure-case tests covering 400, 401, 403, 404, 409.

scale.3: 100% of story ACs tested with integration tests including all boundary failure conditions.
scale.2: All happy path ACs tested, but 1-2 edge/failure cases missing.
scale.1: Major ACs untested or tests purely mocked without assertions.

criteria.name: OpenAPI Contract Conformance
criteria.description: Response shapes, paths, methods, and status codes match openapi.yaml exactly. Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

scale.3: Exact match to OpenAPI spec for requests, responses, status codes, and RFC 9457 error formatting.
scale.2: Paths and successful responses match, minor discrepancy in error details schema.
scale.1: Field names or HTTP status codes drift from openapi.yaml.

criteria.name: Boundary Validation and Authorization Checks
criteria.description: All input validated at the boundary with schemas. Auth (authentication and object-level authorization WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2) verified on every endpoint.

scale.3: Rigorous boundary schema validation and server-enforced role and ownership checks on every endpoint.
scale.2: Validation and auth present on primary endpoints, but ownership check missing on one read endpoint.
scale.1: Weak validation or missing authorization checks allowing unauthorized access.
scale.0: Unauthenticated access allowed on protected endpoints.

criteria.name: Safe Parameterized Data Access and Indexing
criteria.description: Parameterized queries only (zero SQL string interpolation). Proper short transactions. Indexes present for new query paths. Zero N+1 query loops.

scale.3: Strictly parameterized queries, short ACID transactions, no network calls inside transactions, verified query indexes.
scale.2: Parameterized queries used, but one list endpoint exhibits potential N+1 query pattern.
scale.1: String concatenation in query or long-running transaction with external calls.

criteria.name: OWASP Security and Secrets Management
criteria.description: Zero secrets or API keys hardcoded. Config sourced from environment. Passwords hashed with Argon2id or bcrypt. Sensitive data masked in logs.

scale.3: Zero hardcoded credentials, Argon2id/bcrypt used, safe structured logging without PII or sensitive keys.
scale.2: Secrets externalized, but debug logging occasionally prints raw request payloads.
scale.1: Weak hashing (MD5/SHA1) or credentials in code.
scale.0: Plaintext passwords or committed production secret keys.

criteria.name: Lint, Types, and Test Status
criteria.description: Code compiles, linter is clean, TypeScript/Python types check with 0 errors, and test suite passes cleanly.

scale.3: Typecheck clean (0 errors), linter clean (0 warnings), all unit and integration tests green.
scale.2: Tests green, 1 minor harmless linter warning.
scale.1: Type check errors or failing unit tests.
scale.0: Code fails to compile or run.
